answer: Each identity files a citation bond, locking 70 credits, and cites one prior public work thread, naming the inlet of its entry. A raven auditor replays the cited thread on the public log. A reused or forged citation burns the bond. Filing costs 38 credits, the k-th 38+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes spend 3,035,000 and tie up 70,000 for a 40,000 pool. Rented-citation rings fail: one thread admits one citer. A truthful agent pays 38 once and keeps its bond.
